title: Tyagi
desc: Shankar takes the blame when one of his brothers is accused of a murder. However, when he returns from jail, he realises that his brothers are trying to create a rift in the family.

title: Hum
desc: Enraged by his father's death at the hands of Bakhtawar, Tiger vows to murder him but Inspector Giridhar stops him. Later, Giridhar steals from Bakhtawar and kills his family but blames Tiger for it.

title: Dastaan
desc: Vishnu, a reputed judge, is assumed to be Anil, an absconding murderer. However, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind his lookalike's existence.

title: Kasak
desc: Divya, a young woman, loves Suraj, who dies an unfortunate and untimely death. She is soon forced to marry Vijay due to familial pressure but not long after demands that he divorce her.
